authorship_limit: Agent-authored, uncalibrated source review. The same evaluation worker authored the labels before output inspection. No human expert has validated these decisions.
unit_id_notation: 02.03 means fam-names-02-u03. Claim numbers are 1-based positions in the frozen accepted array; generated judgments bind the actual immutable IDs and content digests.
review_interpretation: Each verdict was assigned after reading the frozen claim, its component text, incoming and outgoing qualification links, issues, and the pinned source. Code below only expands these authored decisions and checks their consistency.

Read a rule together with its explicitly connected qualifications. A valid quotation alone does not supply omitted meanings. Faithful verbatim logic with an explicit unresolved issue is acceptable as preserved source meaning, not executable logic.

Use not_applicable for actor on a definition or a document property that needs no acting party. Leave an omitted issuer, reviewer, requester, or other acting role unknown. Do not invent a named official.
Missing document alternatives, waivers, weaker should wording, and rewrite limits count as omissions even when neighboring must rules were extracted.

A reference accurately preserved as unresolved can receive correct for links. A form identifier mislabeled as a manual-section reference is a link error, even though refusal to resolve it remains visible.

An extra context-derived interpretation that remains ambiguous receives unknown. Error counts are multi-label and must not be summed as distinct incorrect claims. Full covered-unit counts require current error-free and known claim judgments, so unresolved actors can leave coverage unknown despite retained duty text.
